item.title: About
item.description: This site is powered by Hugo, uses the hugo-webstack theme, and is built with GitHub Pages. hugo-webstack is a Hugo theme for a purely static website navigation site, based on webstack.cc. Description: you can copy the description from the site itself. In a desktop browser, press F12, search for “desc” in the “Elements” panel, and the first result is usually the one you need.
